subhead: The bill was struck down in Parliament, with 286 voting against and 270 in favor. It would have allowed adults in England and Wales who have been given less than six months to live and can clearly express a wish to die the option to opt to end their own lives.

title: 25 years after 9/11, counterterrorism measures continue to undermine rule of law
subhead: Since 2001, Western countries, led by the United States, have steadily strengthened their counterterrorism powers through criminal and legal measures, prison regimes and mass surveillance tools. These measures have come at the cost of a steady erosion of fundamental rights.

title: China's former Red Guards reflect on their responsibility and regret: 'We were deceived'
subhead: 'Mao's Fraught Legacy' (3/7). Seeking to restore his challenged legitimacy, Mao Zedong called for a Cultural Revolution in 1966.
